Class MultiModalProcessor

java.lang.Object
smile.onnx.genai.MultiModalProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class MultiModalProcessor extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Converts text / images / audios into NamedTensors for multimodal models.
